tsqr_wy_pair.note: Blocked TSQR (linalg.qr, linalg.svd, lstsq, LinearRegression, RSVD_IDN_TSQR_ORTHO): two consecutive 16-column panels share ONE compact-WY trailing update and ONE Q C pass through the merged T2 = [[Ta, -Ta (Ya^T Yb) Tb], [0, Tb]] (panel a factored, its reflectors applied to panel b's columns only, panel b factored, T2 merged, one 32-reflector update of the columns right of the pair). The trailing matrix crosses the device twice per pair instead of twice per panel: half the traffic of the bandwidth-bound update passes (32 multiply-adds per loaded word). Size rule: the pair width is one thread's 32 accumulators and one TS_PART fold page in two rounds; no shape rule. Bits change right of every pair (one 32-wide fold instead of two 16-wide); host replay (ts_wy_host[_, TS_W2], ts_pair_t_host) folds the same chains. NV and AMD must match per arm. NOT COMPILED (lanes never compile), NOT MEASURED.

tsqr_tree_par.note: The TSQR combine tree: each reflector's norm is a 256-lane fixed fold (lane t: alpha^2 for t == 0, then rows i == t mod 256 ascending; halving tree ts_tree_fold) instead of one serial chain recomputed by every thread of the pair's threadgroup; the scaled reflector column is staged in threadgroup memory for the column threads (same words). The Q C tree apply (ts_capply_kernel) tiles C's columns over threadgroups (256 a tile) with the reflector column staged. Bits change in the tree norms only; the column chains are unchanged. Host replay (ts_combine_host) folds the same lanes. NV and AMD must match per arm. NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.

xd_svd_group.note: The small SVD of R (DevExec.svd, the round-robin one-sided Jacobi) enqueues 4 sweeps per convergence readback, each sweep on its own flag slice and lowest-flag word, instead of one wait and one readback per sweep. Bit-neutral: a sweep without a rotation is the identity, so the sweeps enqueued after the converging one change nothing; the convergence test and the X_DECOMP_SVD_SWEEPS bound are the same. Requires IDN_XD_SWEEP (IDENTICAL). NOT COMPILED, NOT MEASURED.
